derived_summary.observer_definition: mapping_count is the number of /proc/PID/maps rows selecting the exact library path; image count is distinct frontend birth identities.

session_text_observation.limit: Sampled process-alive intervals, not a measured request latency or causal stack. All original observations are retained.

sanitization: Absolute guest stages/endpoints and process uid/pid/birth identifiers use stable per-file aliases. All report fields, array lengths, verdicts, counts, timings, hashes, recovery signals, errors and limits are retained. Raw surrounding app logs are excluded except the labeled failure excerpts.
